name: filter_isi_900_1nm
label: ISI 1 nm filter, 900 nm (900 nm)
sources: P. Nugent, 2026-10-21: two 1 nm filters; 900 nm kept, the 1550 nm filter replaced by 650 nm when the silicon PDM replaced the InGaAs ID230
notes: Near the long edge of the silicon response (PDE ~0.11 assumed); the least-resolved photospheric diameter the PDM can reach.
Throughput 0.9 = FILTER_THROUGHPUT (filter + relay optics); the telescope file carries the rest.
Coherence time 2.7 ps, below the PDM's 50 ps jitter: the band width sets the count rate, not the g2 width.
